title: [FEATURE] Add support for Album search without artist
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
There are instances where the artist is banned from ss, but the album still exists if searching without the artist name. For example, the weeknd album: Hurry Up Tomorrow

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
Enable a fallback search without the artist name included
author: ravtakhar

comments.body: What do you mean by saying someone is banned from Soulseek? Does Soulseek ban specific artists?
Yeah, there are some artists that are banned by Soulseek search. Another example is Michael Jackson

Okay, give me a moment. I need to test that and verify my fix.  
You're absolutely right—with `Michael Jackson`, it doesn't find anything, but with `Michael Jacson`, it does. I wasn't aware that Soulseek bans certain artists. Thanks for pointing that out!

title: [FEATURE] ALAC support for Codec Tinker (or ability to pass strings to FFmpeg)
body:
*Hi,

Would it be possible to add ALAC as a target, say when converting from FLAC to ALAC? My current library is all ALAC for easy lossless syncing with my iPhone. Current conversion settings do not allow for ALAC as a source/target. Another option would be to override all existing rules by passing through FFmpegs commands.

Thank you for your time!
author: ralph5150

comments.body:
I've added ALAC support to Tubifarry, which will now be reflected in Codec Tinker. To utilize this feature, you can use the `all->alac` command to convert all codecs to ALAC format. Note that this conversion will only work for codecs that are already lossless, and will not allow conversion from lossy formats like AAC or MP3 to lossless formats like ALAC or FLAC, as this would increase file size without improving audio quality and could be misleading. 
I did not add a dropdown item for ALAC.
